description: This file defines the IntegrationModule entity class, which models a configurable module integrated into the system, including its properties, configurations, and audit information.

classes.name: IntegrationModule
classes.description: An entity class representing an integration module configuration within the system, including properties such as module name, code, regions, configuration details, and audit information.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier (ID) of the integration module.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier (ID) of the integration module.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the module.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the name of the module.

methods.name: getRegions
methods.description: Retrieves the regions associated with the module.

methods.name: setRegions
methods.description: Sets the regions associated with the module.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the module's configuration details as a string.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the module's configuration details.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the unique code identifying the module.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the unique code identifying the module.

methods.name: getModuleConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves the map of environment-specific configurations for the module.

methods.name: setModuleConfigs
methods.description: Sets the map of environment-specific configurations for the module.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image associated with the module.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image associated with the module.

methods.name: isCustomModule
methods.description: Checks if the module is marked as custom.

methods.name: setCustomModule
methods.description: Sets whether the module is custom.

methods.name: getConfigDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed configuration information.

methods.name: setConfigDetails
methods.description: Sets detailed configuration information.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the module.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the module.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section metadata for the entity.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section metadata for the entity.
